text:
Type: white light-filtering curtains, pair
Use: softening daylight, adding light privacy at a window; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, coastal
Materials: lightweight semi-sheer woven fabric, hidden tab heading
Colors: white
Shape: two full-length straight panels hanging in soft relaxed folds, plain fabric, gently translucent, airy and light
Feel: airy, bright, fresh, calm
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, linen sofas, green plants; Scandinavian, minimalist or coastal rooms

product.name: VIVAN
product.description: The curtains let the daylight through but provide privacy so they are perfect to use in a layered window solution.
